basic_profile.bio: PixelEchoes is a 34-year-old tech enthusiast from Barcelona, Spain. With a background in audio engineering, they enjoy blending their professional expertise with their passion for gaming and music. They're a die-hard fan of metalcore music and love exploring new artists in the genre. When not working, they can be found kickboxing at the local gym or binge-watching 'Futurama' episodes. They work as a freelance sound designer and have been in a committed relationship for the past 8 years. Typically, they are active online in the evenings and late at night, often contributing to discussions on audio technology and gaming setups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: PixelEchoes has a degree in Audio Engineering from the University of Barcelona. They have spent over a decade working with various audio technologies and have a deep understanding of sound design and audio equipment. Their expertise is mostly self-taught, honed through years of hands-on experience and continuous learning via online courses and forums.
